subject: The flight deck of the colony ship ariadne at night, two officers on watch, stars in the big window. Andrea closed Toby's left palm once, on the launch docks, after he caught a falling cargo strap bare-handed to keep it off a trainee. He wrote her a full page of thanks the next morning, and she has never mentioned it. The white line across his hand is from that night. Neither of them has said a word about it in four hours. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
